## What this changes and why

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] UX / accessibility fix
- [ ] New card, deck, or resource (see `CONTRIBUTING.md` content rules)
- [ ] Other code change

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] For UI changes: checked keyboard-only, and in both light and dark
- [ ] For content changes: follows the editorial checklist in `README.md`;
      any quotation is already documented in `research/sources.md`
- [ ] Doesn't introduce scores, streaks, accounts, analytics, or pressure
      to keep drawing cards (see `PRD.md`)
